BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
you might wonder.

What do we need to get started?+

A short introduction to your business, your project goals and your preferred timeline is enough. If you have references or inspiration, mention them in your brief.

What if I don’t have a clear idea yet?+

We start with the challenge and the goal. You don’t need to know the final answer; finding the creative direction is part of the process.

How are timelines and costs determined?+

Once the requirements, deliverables and priorities are clear, we can define a realistic timeline and project budget.

Can I choose just one service?+

Absolutely. A project can focus on one specific need or bring several connected services together.
